thread:
Alex: Heads-up: holding runtime v3.2.0 rollout for EU tonight. DeployBot flagged increased p95 token latency on quantized llama3q for >1k seq. Need clearance before unpin.

DeployBot: Auto-hold applied to runtime-group/eu. Reason: p95_token_latency_1k > threshold (1.8x baseline). See run: https://deploys/redwood/1768504322

Marta: Seen the alert. Canary telemetry shows latency spike only on batch size 1 / q4_0_4bit profile. Multi-batch looks ok. Repro in perf-lab?

Ryan: I reproduced locally on rtxA100 with q4_0_4bit + kvcache enabled. Attaching logs: ```ERROR: tail latency spikes at step 120-150ms -> 420ms```

Anika: Is this affecting hosted? Any customer-facing errors? SLOs?

Alex: Hosted EU saw small error % bump but no 5xxs. Mostly increased tail latency, some timeouts at 30s on heavy long-seq queries. No rollback yet.

Jamie: Suggest we add temporary routing rule -> route longseq requests to runtime v3.1.x until root cause clear. Can we do a quick fallback using routing policy?

Marta: Yes. I can apply route: ```route.longseq -> runtime:v3.1.x``` in 30s; will monitor. Also will run full perf test with kvcache toggled.

DeployBot: Applied soft-route override for tenant:longseq with priority 200. Will expire in 3h unless extended.

Ryan: Hypothesis: kernel scheduling change in v3.2.0 increases memcpy overhead for q4_0 path. Patch candidate in branch: runtime/fix/q4-memcpy. Benchmark indicates 20% p95 improvement.

Anika: If we trust the patch, can we do a canary redeploy to one EU rack? Need checklist: 1) perf-lab repro 2) canary deploy + 30m observation 3) metric gating 4) ops signoff

Alex: Agreed. Marta and Ryan own tests; Anika to initiate canary; I'll hold hands with SRE. If canary passes, we lift hold and schedule remainder rollout in next 2h window.

Marta: Starting perf run now. Kicking off job id perf-1768504380. Will paste results in thread.

Marta: perf run complete: p95 baseline 120ms -> v3.2.0 380ms; patch branch 140ms. Looks promising. Logs: ```p95: baseline=120 v3.2.0=380 patch=140```

Anika: Canaries scheduled on eu-rack-7. Rolling now.

DeployBot: Canary deploy started: runtime:v3.2.0-patch -> eu-rack-7. Monitoring gates: p95_token_latency, error_rate, memory. Alert if p95 > 1.5x baseline.

Jamie: Observing metrics; no user-facing errors. p95 holds ~130ms. I'll keep an eye for 30m.

Alex: Good. After 30m if stable we lift hold and update release notes: add note about q4_0 fix and routing fallback. Also open PR for changelog.

Marta: Canary stable at 45m. Requesting unhold.

DeployBot: Hold removed for runtime-group/eu by Alex. Rollout to remaining EU racks scheduled with 10m splay.

Anika: I'll trigger rollout. Also adding postmortem doc link: https://docs/internal/runbooks/runtime-q4-longseq

Ryan: PR: #2345 merged. Cherry-picked into release branch. Thanks team.

Jamie: Updating incident channel and product that a temporary routing override occurred. @support FYI.

Alex: Closing thread. Good catch—nice fast turnaround :thumbsup:
